$comment: MoistureShield (composite decking, cladding and railing, MoistureShield / Cascades) runs a WordPress site with server-rendered product pages under /products/<category>/<line>/ (Vision, Meridian, Vantage, Elevate). The product name is the h1, but the feature list, warranties and lengths are rendered by the page's tabs and sections in a way the selectors cannot read; there is no price (dealers sell the decking), so price is not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the live AI page fetch returns the image, the feature list (7 features) and 3 specs (lengths, structural and fade warranties), each checked against the page, at about 2,641+1,236 tokens per request. The selectors are the http fallback and the saved fixture (title only). Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title only; browser: SUCCESS with title and image, 5 features; ai-crawler-avalai (AI page fetch over http): SUCCESS with image, 7 features and 3 specs, the most complete; web_search: success but unverified. ai-crawler-avalai (AI page fetch) is selected because it returns the warranties and the feature list. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the saved (curl) MoistureShield Vision page on 2026-11-19.
